newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BTR to build A$28 mln Australia foundry.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BTR to build A$28 mln Australia foundry.

text.p: Australian manufacturer BTR Nylex Ltd, a subsidiary of British industrial conglomerate BTR Plc, announced on Thursday it would spend A$28 million to build a new metal-casting foundry in Adelaide.

BTR Nylex said the foundry would be built at an industrial park on the city's outskirts for the casting division of BTR's automotive engineering division, which supplies iron and aluminium castings to the car and engineering industries.
The plant is scheduled to begin operating in early 1998.
"The establishment of the Wingfield plant will allow BTR Engineering to more than double the capacity of its South Australian foundry (operations)," BTR Nylex said.
